representativeSnapshot.kind: static source review of the active ticketing chain: ticket_sales (20260328130000_ticketing_v2.sql) carries metadata jsonb not null default '{}', buyer_user_id uuid nullable, event_id uuid not null; reconcile_ticketing_foundation (20260821000000) added order_number / stripe_checkout_session_id / webhook_event_id with three partial unique indexes but no buyer-scoped idempotency key; contract-test SHA-256 c49f7a673b5f55e71b823ff19db3a994c45f33473e444e5b249e9ccc277b6e3d

layeredPlan: Layer 0 (preflight, read-only, operator): count existing duplicate (buyer_user_id, event_id, metadata->>'idempotency_key') combinations on public.ticket_sales; must be zero (or quarantined) before the index build, because CREATE UNIQUE INDEX fails if duplicates exist

Layer 1 (apply, single statement, operator): CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ticket_sales_purchase_idempotency ON public.ticket_sales (buyer_user_id, event_id, (metadata ->> 'idempotency_key')) WHERE metadata ->> 'idempotency_key' IS NOT NULL — no table rewrite, no column added, no data touched; ShareLock held only across the partial index build

Layer 2 (postflight, read-only, operator): run supabase/tests/db005b_ticketing_idempotency_contract.sql; expect zero violation rows and the single summary row with purchase_idempotency_index_ready = true

Layer 3 (runtime certification, release/ops): rerun the TICKET-005 purchase-idempotency vitest suite (__tests__/ticketing/purchase-idempotency.test.ts) against the staged target and run a two-concurrent-first-request probe proving exactly one row is created per (buyer, event, key); the second insert must surface the unique violation instead of a duplicate row

preflight.expectedAffectedRows: DDL only: one unique index plus one comment; zero rows changed

execution.resumeStrategy: Authored - manual apply pending (CP-051). Apply to an approved staging target once, via `supabase migration up` with the exact file or a targeted psql apply; a partial or failed apply is corrected with a later additive forward fix, never a replay or reset
execution.idempotency: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS and COMMENT ON INDEX are deterministic and repeatable; no object creation requires a pre-check, and no DML is executed

quarantine.strategy: No data movement or quarantine; if Layer 0 finds pre-existing duplicate key combinations, the operator quarantines or reconciles those rows before applying

constraints: No CHECK, FK, or NOT NULL constraints are added or changed; nullability of buyer_user_id, event_id, and metadata is untouched
indexes: Adds partial unique index idx_ticket_sales_purchase_idempotency on ticket_sales(buyer_user_id, event_id, (metadata ->> 'idempotency_key')) where metadata ->> 'idempotency_key' is not null
Existing partial unique indexes idx_ticket_sales_order_number, idx_ticket_sales_stripe_session, and idx_ticket_sales_webhook_event remain untouched
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Post-apply catalog probes via supabase/tests/db005b_ticketing_idempotency_contract.sql assert the index exists, is unique, carries the metadata->>'idempotency_key' expression and partial predicate, and indexes buyer_user_id plus event_id; runtime behavior is certified by the TICKET-005 concurrent-first-request probe in Layer 3

recovery.rollback: No objects are dropped and no data is rewritten, so rollback means accepting the constraint: if the unique index must be removed, drop idx_ticket_sales_purchase_idempotency through an explicit reviewed additive migration
recovery.forwardFix: Extend scope (e.g., a dedicated idempotency_key column or payment_status-aware predicate) through a later additive migration; never re-apply or replay the chain
